newsitem.title: PERU: Cementos Lima to fix bond issue details July 8.
newsitem.headline: Cementos Lima to fix bond issue details July 8.

text.p: Peru's biggest cement producer, Cementos Lima, will determine July 8 the date of its issue of $60 million in corporate bonds, a report from the Lima stock Exchange said Friday.
The bonds will be issued in three series with an annual interest rate of between eight and ten percent.
"They could be placed at par, below par, or above par, depending on the conditions of the market at the time of issue," said a recent bolsa report.
The Cementos Lima bonds will have a maturity of four years and will be managed by Banco de Credito and Interinvest brokerage.
The money raised is intended to finance the expansion of the company's factory in Atocongo.
